responsibility: Implements assorted core IPA optimizations and reachability/dataflow utilities that do not belong to a single specialized pass. It contains routines for preserving and walking polymorphic call targets during reachability, constructor/destructor merging support, and the single-use variable dataflow that marks variables referenced from only one function. This file serves as a miscellaneous IPA pass hub above the raw cgraph/symtab layers but below more focused passes like inlining or constant propagation.
